description: Users can use a short verify=no shortcut flag instead of typing the full option name to disable SSL verification.
When no hostname is passed HTTPie must default the request to localhost so that commands like http :8080 work correctly.
Sessions must support multiple headers that share the same name instead of overwriting earlier values with later ones.
HTTPie must detect DNS resolution failures and display a clear useful error message instead of a generic connection error.
HTTPie must support Bearer token authentication by allowing users to pass a token that is sent in the Authorization header.
HTTPie must accept a shorthand where a colon-slash-slash prefix is interpreted as using the following word as the URL scheme.
Responses with the same or sufficiently similar content and the same IP are treated as duplicates.
Responses with the same or sufficiently similar content but different IPs are not treated as duplicates.
Responses with different content are not treated as duplicates even when the IP is the same.
Near-duplicate response content is treated as duplicate when the SimHash distance is less than or equal to 3 and the IP is the same.
Near-duplicate response content with different IPs is not treated as duplicate.
When the response IP is empty deduplication falls back to content similarity.
Multiple subdomains returning the same or similar content from the same IP are deduplicated.
Multiple subdomains returning the same or similar content from different IPs are retained separately.
